parsed.explanation: Tier-2 exposure dominates: state threat-framing (Oct 2025 presidential decree listing LGBTQ+ people as national-defense threats) coincides with a documented surge of vigilante mob attacks on trans women (Aug 2026), police venue raids (75 arrested, June 2025), and a trans traveller's death in custody amid alleged police beating and extortion. The penal code in force since Jan 2026 criminalizes all consensual same-sex relations (2 years); Aceh's religious code canes a 'person with gender disorder.' Censorship, pathologization by the psychiatric association, and no anti-discrimination protection leave failed recourse; protective police circulars are unsourced as to enforcement. Prosecution is selective and no presentation offence or registry exists nationally, so this sits below arrest-on-sight regimes — but current, patterned, state-implicated hostility with imprisonment/caning severity warrants the severe band.
